summary.value: The Manhattan Club is an all-suite hotel at 200 W 56th St. New York, NY 10019, with Carnegie Hall, 2 minute walk from the door and Central Park a few blocks north. It suits families and small groups who want separate space: Trip.com guests report The rooms were spacious and with enough privacy for everyone and The location to central park was awesome and the staff were great. Its distinguishing perk is the member-only Club Lounge and Terraces, a quiet retreat from Midtown.

description.value: The Manhattan Club is an all-suite hotel in Midtown Manhattan at 200 W 56th St. Its official site says Carnegie Hall is a two minute walk away. Guests also get a member-only Club Lounge and Terraces, which makes it a calm base between Central Park and the Theater District. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “The rooms were spacious and with enough privacy for everyone”; “The location to central park was awesome and the staff were great”.
